description: Independent hosted adaptation of official MCP Apps examples.

apps.name: Get Time
apps.summary: Read the server clock and refresh it from a compact interactive app.
apps.screenshotAlt: Get Time MCP App showing a server timestamp and interaction controls.
apps.dataNote: No user data; returns only the current server timestamp.
apps.samplePrompt: Show me the current server time using the interactive app.
apps.compatibility: SDK v2 current protocol plus stateless 2025-era fallback; see benchmark report for release proof.

apps.name: Budget Allocator
apps.summary: Adjust a synthetic company budget and compare allocations with stage benchmarks.
apps.screenshotAlt: Budget Allocator MCP App with category sliders, a budget chart, and benchmark controls.
apps.dataNote: Fixed synthetic categories, history, and benchmarks; nothing is saved.
apps.samplePrompt: Create a $1 million seed-stage budget I can adjust interactively.
apps.compatibility: SDK v2 current protocol plus stateless 2025-era fallback; see benchmark report for release proof.

apps.name: Cohort Heatmap
apps.summary: Explore a bounded synthetic retention cohort heatmap across time periods.
apps.screenshotAlt: Cohort Heatmap MCP App showing a color-coded retention grid.
apps.dataNote: Deterministic synthetic cohorts; at most 12 cohorts by 12 periods.
apps.samplePrompt: Show me an interactive customer-retention cohort heatmap.
apps.compatibility: SDK v2 current protocol plus stateless 2025-era fallback; see benchmark report for release proof.

apps.name: Customer Segmentation
apps.summary: Filter a deterministic synthetic customer portfolio by segment and engagement.
apps.screenshotAlt: Customer Segmentation MCP App plotting synthetic customers by revenue and engagement.
apps.dataNote: Fixed synthetic customer records; filters are bounded and no uploads are accepted.
apps.samplePrompt: Let me explore customers by revenue and engagement.
apps.compatibility: SDK v2 current protocol plus stateless 2025-era fallback; see benchmark report for release proof.

apps.name: Scenario Modeler
apps.summary: Compare bounded synthetic SaaS growth plans and tune financial assumptions.
apps.screenshotAlt: Scenario Modeler MCP App with SaaS parameter sliders and projection charts.
apps.dataNote: Synthetic templates and local calculations; no financial data is stored.
apps.samplePrompt: Compare a bootstrapped plan with a venture-funded growth plan.
apps.compatibility: SDK v2 current protocol plus stateless 2025-era fallback; see benchmark report for release proof.

apps.name: Transcript
apps.summary: Try a local browser speech-transcription interface with explicit microphone permission.
apps.screenshotAlt: Transcript MCP App with microphone controls and a navigable transcript panel.
apps.dataNote: Audio stays in the browser; the server receives no audio and stores no transcript.
apps.samplePrompt: Show me an interactive transcript I can navigate.
apps.compatibility: SDK v2 current protocol plus stateless 2025-era fallback; see benchmark report for release proof.
